notes.title: UPDATE JANUARY 3rd 2022
notes.notes:
UPDATE JANUARY 3rd 2022
This update includes
•	Retraining players is now showing on training overview
•	French Division 3 pool buttons now work better

notes.title: Dedicated 2021/22 Season Update
notes.notes:
Rugby Union Team Manager has now been updated to include a dedicated 2021/22 Season.

This new update includes :

Season 2021/22 clubs
Season 2021/22 fixtures
Season 2021/22 kits
Season 2021/22 players

This new update is accessible at the start of both RUTM3 and RUTM3 DLC.

Please enjoy and thank you for all your support!

notes.title: The British & Irish Cats Tour to South Africa is now available in RUTM3 DLC.
notes.notes:
The British & Irish Cats Tour to South Africa has now been added to  RUTM3 DLC.

The Tour game includes :  
The opportunity to play as either South Africa or the British & Irish Cats
35-man squad selection
5 warm-up games for South Africa against various International teams
5 warm-up games for British & Irish Cats against South African Super Championship teams
3 Tour Test matches, South Africa vs British & Irish Cats
All the tactics and team selection from the main RUTM3 game
Full match engine from the main RUTM3 game
The RUTM3 Tour game is accessible form the main menu of the RUTM3 DLC . . .

Please note: You must install RUTM3 DLC in order to play.

notes.title: Faster Processing Update
notes.notes:
We have optimised the processing of fortnightly changes.  It can now be up to 6 times faster than previous builds.

Get this update for an even better experience.
Thanks for your feedback and please continue to enjoy the game!

notes.title: New Update
notes.notes:
We've added the Kit Preview tool to the main menu of the game, for preview only of 3D kit files.  Use this to see how kit textures that you have modified yourself, using your own graphics software, look on the 3D player model. You can also render 2D shirts for the UI from your designs.

We have also added International stats to the DLC.

notes.title: Workshop Database Sharing And More
notes.notes:
A separate Steam Workshop tool has been added to the in game editor.  This allows you to save and upload workshop database files that you can then upload to the Steam Workshop community area.

We have left the editor slots for game databases as they were.
The workshop area is an addition and you can now share your database files using the Steam Workshop.

Please read the guide for a full explanation by pressing the Learn More button in the Community Workshop area in your Steam client..

We have also added 4 new advanced moves to RUTM3 and RUTM3 DLC.
These moves are available in the Ad-Lib Attack buttons and have also
been incorporated into the Structured attack.

We have added International Rankings to RUTM3 DLC, so you can keep
track of where your International club ranks in the world at any time.

notes.title: Return Kick Feature
notes.notes:
Return Kick button now live in RUTM3 and RUTM3 DLC.

We have now added a Return Kick feature, in the form of a button which
appears at the appropriate time giving you the option, there and then, of returning
a kick.

notes.title: October 12th update
notes.notes: Sendings off and sin bins are now fully operational in all versions of the game , both RUM3 and RUTM3+DLC[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37961859/ccd5d976ab043f262e6e2310787982becb4654f5.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Major Update
notes.notes:
[h2]Thank you for your support![/h2]

Based on your feedback, we are pleased to announce the following additions to the game :-

[h3]Attribute Search Screen[/h3]
We have now added the Attributes Screen to the game .
This allows you to search for players by an attribute value range, then add to the Player Shortlist to sign them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37961859/4080065e492d97254721e4113c42bb78c096f424.png[/img]

[h3]Box Kicking[/h3]
We have added box kicking to the match.  For auto-manage and structured attack,
the box kick will be utilised automatically, and for ad-lib attack, the box kick move
button can be found directly below the normal kick move button

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37961859/6d177472ba6d25aa3807a47ba8c1d722e4d92b11.jpg[/img]

[h3]The Stats Hub[/h3]
We have added :-  “The Stats Hub“ which is now live in both RUTM3 and RUTM3 DLC.
Which allows you to search players statistics, for a given league.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37961859/adca2989b5f9d7e2275cd8dac9898d1b0cc94145.png[/img]

[h3]Overall Stat[/h3]
We have added “Overall” to the Player Attributes Popup which is accessible on most screens To access you just hover over the icon. There's one for all players on most screens.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37961859/31d5fffa8aa5e69c8b1e944990d30fdc60abe378.png[/img]

notes.title: French Language Update
notes.notes:
The latest update for RUTM3 now has a French language option.  Simply select it from the start screen and all menus, emails etc... are now translated into French.

Download Now and Enjoy!
